trigger: concurrency/ordering (two-file write), irreversible state transition (run -> complete)

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the config write and the loop-state write cannot leave an inconsistent pair
doubts.disproof_attempt: The loop stamp runs after the locked config write, outside the lock; if save_loop_state fails or the process dies between them, run_config says complete and the loop says stopped, and a retried skip cannot heal it because _completion_unblocked returns False on a complete run so mark_loop_complete is never reached.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Make mark_loop_complete self-healing: call it whenever the run's status is complete, not only on the transition.

doubts.disproof_attempt: recover X failed (run stays needs_validation), then recover Y skipped: TERMINAL_STATUSES counts failed as terminal so the run completes with X failed. complete_phase_task applies the same rule, but the stated claim is only true one call at a time.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Require no failed task, or rebut as matching complete_phase_task and reword the claim; add a failed-then-skip test either way.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: absence of validation_issues reliably means the lifecycle produced the pause
doubts.disproof_attempt: A malformed v1 pause with validation_issues [] would be popped by update_step while status stays needs_validation, indistinguishable from the lifecycle pause.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: A positive lifecycle marker, or rebut that v1 configs never reach this state.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: mark_loop_complete on the generic CLI is safe for non-single-session configs
doubts.disproof_attempt: The router path has no mode check; only loop_state presence and runId match guard it.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Add an is_single_session(config) check or document why runId suffices.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: completing on all-terminal never closes a run with unmaterialised work
doubts.disproof_attempt: Skipping an open plan/split-N does not plan its build successor, so the run completes with split N never built.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Accept as operator intent and document, or check for unmaterialised successors.

summary: Core locked write holds; two medium doubts (non-healing loop stamp; failed-then-skip completes) and three lows must be fixed or rebutted.
